column2:
Unique identifier for the student. 
1)  Integer Only, No Alpha Characters. 
2) Leading zeros will be dropped.                        3) Maximum digits is 13.
column3: SchoolID is used to ensure student is placed into the correct school in a district. (Must be used when importing students at the District level and must match a school number in PowerSchool.)
column4:
First Name of  student.  
Up to 50 characters. (State reporting may impact the number of characters. Please check the guide.)
column5: Middle Name of student. Up to 30 characters. (State reporting may impact the number of characters. Please check the guide.)
column6: Last Name of  student. Up to 50 characters. (State reporting may impact the number of characters. Please check the guide.)
column7:
Grade level for the student for your go-live year.

Kindergarten=0 
PK4 = -1
PK3 = -2
Imports will accept -3 and -4 for grade levels lower than PK4 and PK3.
column8: Student's home phone number.  Should be formatted the same for all students in order for Family Management to use this field for matching. Default format: 123-456-1221
column9: Students gender.  Must be either M or F, unless further codes are defined in District Setup.
column10:
Scheduling/Reporting Ethnicity is used for the Enrollment Summary screen in PowerSchool. Additional set up may be necessary for Federal Ethnicity. Students ethnicity must match a value defined as an Ethnicity Code in the District setup, for example C = Caucasian. If some students have an ethnicity defined, all must have an ethnicity code.

There is a 4-character max for the code.
column11: Ethnicity: Is the student Hispanic or Latino?                           0=No                                   1=Yes
column12: Students Date of Birth. Date format must match the Default Locale.
column13: Full-Time Equivalency.  **Identify each student has Fulltime (FT) or Halftime (PT) and that value will be translated before import. Ask your Project Manager for assistance on this system generated field information.
column14:
Lets the application know if the student is active.                    -1=Preregistered 0=Active   
1=Inactive           2=Transferred Out      3=Graduated
column15: Date student began school in the current full year term. Date format must match the Default Locale.
column16: Day after the last day of current the school year. Date format must match the Default Locale.
column17: First date student attended school in the district. Date format must match the Default Locale.
column18: First date student attended school in the school. Date format must match the Default Locale.
column19: **Entry Code  must match a value defined as an Entry Code in PowerSchool.
column20: Student's physical street address. **Character limit is 80.
column22: Student's physical state address. **Verify foreign addresses are added to the code sets.
column28: Student's assigned number from the state department of education. **This number should be different than the PowerSchool Student_Number.
column29: Next Grade Level Indicator.  Use this field to set the grade level a student will be for the next year.  Needs to be set before the end of year process.  Enter 99 for students currently in the highest grade level in the "district". For all other students enter the next year's grade level. **If the student isn't returning next school year, leave this field blank.
column30: Next School Indicator.  Lets the application know what school the student will promote to during the End-of-Year Process. Must match the School Number in PowerSchool. For students who are attending this district's LAST grade level, enter a "999999" in this field.
column31: Schedule this Student.  This field becomes a checkbox in PowerSchool.  Having the field checked (with a value of 1) allows PowerScheduler to schedule the student.  It is recommended as  a best practice to have this as a value for all students.
column32: Scheduled year of graduation.  This field is useful in PowerScheduler.  It is recommended as a best practice to have this field identified for all students. **Will only take a 4 digit year.
column33: Entry Comment. **No hard returns in the data.
column34: Unique number per family assigned to all members of the same family.  Optional - Can be used in place of phone number to identify family members that should be linked. **Not linked to other Family tools. This is a District responsibility to set up.
column35: Students HomeRoom.   This text field is particularly useful for elementary schools when mass enrolling students. **Not connected to the student's actual schedule.
